summary: Removed whole optional sentences and clauses across the draft, an estimated net reduction of about 520 words. All seven protected excerpts and every essential function were kept: the Wide-Awakes, no one planning the war, Washington as a rude colony, Southern ignorance, the New England type, Raymond, Sumner versus Seward, the Seward portrait, the Virginia tactics, Hay, Scott, Lincoln at the ball, the Sumner rupture and maxim, and the return to Horace Gray. Surviving sentences are otherwise unchanged except for two small repairs.
